summary: Verification round: review-scope exited 0, with 1 of 44 blocks changed (2%, s2-layers) and sections and objectives unchanged. The previous pedagogy review had no open must-fix items, so resolved is empty. The change fixes visual-qa's mobile defect: on mobile-jp-07 both branch nodes and the edge labels 「サンドボックスの中／外」 fit, with 5 nodes and no mermaid errors. The alt now matches the drawing. The change also removed the VM frame, so q2's hint 「…図で確かめましょう」 now sends the learner to a drawing with no enclosure. That regression is the single must-fix: change the hint in s2-check, or restore a drawn VM frame. Re-scored criteria: load 3, active 3, visual 3, accuracy 4, voice 3, a11y_l10n 3; the others are carried over. validate and strict lint are clean, measure.mjs gives est 17.2 min against estMinutes 17, and no paragraph has more than 3 sentences. Mean 3.38 with every criterion ≥ 3; the verdict is revise because of the must-fix.
